status.idle: Click to spin · drag to throw
status.todo_empty: No open items in the todo list

picker.name: Spinning Wheel
picker.description: A click-to-spin / drag-to-flick wheel with momentum-based physics.

editor.name: Title
editor.source: Where do the segments come from?
editor.no_labels: No labels yet. The wheel shows the numbers 1 to {count}.
editor.max_segments: The wheel has room for 24 segments at most.
editor.segments_each: Every segment has its own label.
editor.todo_entity_helper: Up to 24 open items go on the wheel.
editor.todo_count: {count} open items make {count} segments, in the list's order.
editor.todo_empty: This list has no open items right now. The wheel stays empty until you add one.
editor.todo_none: Pick a list. Until then the wheel shows your own list.

row.label: Label
row.label_helper: Text or an icon, e.g. mdi:pizza
row.text_helper: Automatic picks black or white to suit the fill.
row.weight_helper: Higher values make the segment larger and more likely. 2 counts twice as much as 1.
row.action_helper: Runs when the wheel stops on this segment.
row.action_yaml_note: This action is set in the code editor. Change it there.

editor.theme_helper: Used for segments without their own fill colour.
editor.language_helper: Used for the hub and the status line.
editor.labels_todo: With a to-do list, labels always run along the spokes and shrink when needed.
editor.label_font_scale_helper_fit: Acts as the largest size. Long labels get smaller.
editor.label_radius_offset_helper: Negative values move labels toward the centre, positive toward the rim.
editor.label_flip_helper_tangent: Handy when labels mostly land at the bottom of the wheel.
editor.label_flip_helper_radial: Text then runs from the centre outward.
editor.hub_pick: In pick mode the hub shows no text.
editor.segment_borders_helper: Without them the wheel looks flatter, which suits bold palettes.
editor.pegs_helper: Like a real prize wheel: each peg clicks and slows the wheel a little.
editor.mode_pick_desc: Drag to the pointer and let go
editor.friction_helper: The wheel stops after about {seconds} s. 1 spins long, 10 brakes hard.
editor.boost_helper: Clicking the spinning wheel speeds it up again. Throwing always works.
editor.sound_helper: Clicks at every segment, louder when the wheel is fast.
editor.click_sound_wood_desc: Warm, with a hint of pitch
editor.confirm_helper: Otherwise even a casual spin can trigger an action.
editor.result_entity_helper: A text helper gets the result after every spin, so automations can react to it.
editor.result_entity_create_failed: Couldn't create the helper. The browser console shows why.
editor.light_sync_entities_helper: Colour-capable lights take on the winning segment's colour.
editor.tts_announce_entities_helper: Speaks the result after every spin.
editor.tts_engine_helper: Pronunciation follows the engine's own settings.
editor.tts_engine_missing: Pick a text-to-speech engine, or nothing is said.
editor.wheel_context_helper: Scripts receive wheel_label, wheel_color and more fields, so one script can serve every segment.

errors.segments_range: segments must be an integer between 4 and 24
errors.friction_range: friction must be an integer between 1 and 10 (or one of the legacy presets: low, medium, high)
errors.labels_type: labels must be an array of strings
errors.labels_length: labels length ({len}) must not exceed segments ({segments})
errors.weights_type: weights must be an array of positive numbers
errors.weights_empty: weights must contain at least one entry
errors.weights_length: weights length ({len}) must not exceed segments ({segments})
errors.colors_type: colors must be an array of non-empty strings
errors.colors_empty: colors must contain at least one entry
errors.colors_length: colors length ({len}) must not exceed segments ({segments})
errors.label_colors_type: label_colors must be an array of non-empty strings
errors.label_colors_empty: label_colors must contain at least one entry
errors.label_colors_length: label_colors length ({len}) must not exceed segments ({segments})
errors.click_sound_value: click_sound must be one of: classic, wood, flapper, pin, felt, ratchet
errors.theme_value: theme must be one of: default, pastel, pride, neon
errors.hub_color_value: hub_color must be one of: theme, black, white
errors.todo_entity_invalid: todo_entity must be a todo.* entity_id
errors.actions_type: actions must be an array of script.* entity IDs, action objects, or null entries
errors.actions_length: actions length ({len}) must not exceed segments ({segments})
errors.actions_string: actions string entries must be a script.* entity_id (got: {value})
errors.peg_density_range: peg_density must be an integer between 0 and 4
errors.label_font_scale_range: label_font_scale must be an integer between 70 and 150
errors.label_radius_offset_range: label_radius_offset must be an integer between -20 and 20
errors.light_sync_entities_type: light_sync_entities must be an array of light.* entity IDs
errors.light_sync_entities_invalid: light_sync_entities entry must be a light.* entity_id (got: {value})
errors.tts_engine_invalid: tts_engine must be a tts.* entity_id
errors.tts_announce_entities_type: tts_announce_entities must be an array of media_player.* entity IDs
errors.tts_announce_entities_invalid: tts_announce_entities entry must be a media_player.* entity_id (got: {value})
errors.result_entity_invalid: result_entity must be an input_text.* entity_id
